source-fidelity.evidence: Not checked: Corroborating NIST single-variance page (eda358) not opened by reviewer.

scope.evidence: Normal-population variance test sensitive to nonnormality; both variances must share squared scale (no percent/decimal mixing).

dimensions.evidence: (n-1)[1]*variance[data-unit^2]/null_variance[data-unit^2] gives unit-1 chi-square. data-unit^2, sample_observation_count, sample_variance, hypothesized_population_variance, single_variance_chi_square_statistic are new (extension).

guards-inverses.evidence: n>=2, variance>=0, null_variance>0. Inverses variance=chi2*null/(n-1); null=(n-1)*variance/chi2 needs chi2>0; variance=0 leaves null unidentified, correctly.
